final.report:
DELPHI's validate_generation was run on the generated design "winged-zebrafish" against the base "zebrafish-adult". Both were supplied as repository design ids and both resolved to design documents. The generated design has n_edits 0 and no gene-level edit. The desired phenotype ("a zebrafish that glides at least 5 m from a 1 m launch and survives 10-30 C as an adult") parsed into 3 hard adult-stage criteria. c1 is glide_range_total_m >= 5 m from a 1 m launch. c2 is survival at 10 C. c3 is survival at 30 C. Nothing was unparsed or refused. The parser's assumptions were: adult stage assumed for one criterion, no editable parameters so the optimizer has nothing to vary, and Lean constraints always must-hold. Functional analogues were chosen from function: flying fishes (Exocoetidae) for gliding, and zebrafish (Danio rerio) for the eurythermal window.

The five results are reported side by side. They are not summed, averaged, counted or scored.

- genotype_similarity: cannot-assess. There is no gene-level edit, so no genotype was assessed. This is not a pass. A parameter delta has no allele to score.
- phenotype_similarity: pass. The design is inside the calibrated shape distribution (body p 1). This is shape similarity, not relatedness, and it is silent on every feature the comparison does not read.
- lean_check: cannot-assess. No Lean law could be evaluated (25 cannot-evaluate, 10 out of scope). No accepted-law violation was found, but that is not the same as the laws holding.
- functional_resolution: fail. 19 differences from the closest functional analogue are unresolved.
- physics_check: fail. The glide criterion is not met. The reachable launch speed is 0.67 m/s against a v_min of 8.64 m/s. The glide was achieved in 0.0% of 200 draws (median 0 m). The lifting area is 1.91 cm2 against 317.76 cm2 needed. The output does not report c2 or c3 (survival at 10 C and 30 C) as assessed, so I make no claim about them.

Verdict: the word "validated" is withheld (word_validated_withheld true). The reasons given are 2 gate(s) failed, 2 gate(s) could not be assessed, 3 biological scale(s) could not be assessed, and no sequence was compared at any locus. The report states it is not a validity claim.

Not assessed: no sequence (document-only, loci_covered 0, genome_fraction_assessed 0). The cell, tissue and organ_system scales are not assessable. They are empty rather than clear, because naming a term is not assessing it. Organ and body are assessable. Each omics layer swept only 9 of the 3478 genes annotated at the touched anatomy, so coverage is limited to those 9.

The output also carries composite_score_from_the_scorer = 0.878. That is the scorer thread's own frozen number, carried for reference. It is not the verdict, no gate feeds it, and it should not be read as the outcome.
